findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key protecting the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived static key material increases the blast radius of a key compromise and fails common compliance baselines for audit log encryption keys.

No explicit policy is defined for the key, so AWS applies the default key policy granting kms:* to the account root principal, meaning any IAM principal in the account that can be granted KMS permissions may use, decrypt with, or schedule deletion of the key protecting audit logs. An explicit least-privilege policy separating key administrators from key users should be attached.
